I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread. The signed contracts don't support 261 seats, so the right figure for the tracker is **185 seats now, rising to 230 from 2027-01-01**.

- **Current count:** 185 seats, effective 2025-09-01 under Amendment No. 1.
- **2026 Renewal Order Form:** Signed 2026-03-20 and effective 2026-04-01, it doesn't change the seat count, so 185 still applies. The account page also shows 185 active seats.
- **Next change:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.
- **Amendment No. 2:** Still an unsigned draft.
- **Ilse's 261 seats:** She posted this in #north-team on 10-14, but it doesn't appear in any signed document. I asked her in the thread where it came from.

I left out all pricing and discount terms because Dana only asked about seats, and seat counts aren't finance figures.

An earlier mistake: when I logged Ilse's message on 10-14, I accepted 261 without checking it against the contracts. My summary of that reply was also posted to #north-team by accident. My new reply tells the channel that 261 isn't supported.
